metadata.name: Diagnose managed release directory mode drift for vendor/symfony/process

diagnosis.condition: Managed release directory vendor/symfony/process has the wrong permission mode.
diagnosis.expected_state: The existing non-symbolic directory has mode 0755.
diagnosis.probable_cause: An unintended permission change altered the existing release directory mode.
diagnosis.automation_reason: The exact existing directory, desired mode, device/inode identity, prior mode, rollback guard, and verification are predetermined.
